name: Sign up from landing page
description: Visitor lands on homepage, scrolls features, clicks 'Start listening' CTA
persona: Product manager at a company running an AI chatbot who wants visibility into conversation quality and customer sentiment
preconditions: Visitor does not have an existing OpenBat account

steps.action: Land on the homepage at openbat.dev — hero section visible with 'Google Analytics for AI chatbots' heading
Scroll through feature sections (problem statement, ingest & analyze, system prompt suggestions, stakeholder notifications, analytics, integration code)
Click 'Start listening' button (appears in nav header, mid-page CTA, and bottom CTA) — opens inline 'Get started' modal with work email field, NOT a redirect to /auth/sign-up
Enter email in modal and click 'Sign up' — shows 'You're in. Check your inbox; we'll be in touch with next steps shortly.' confirmation

expectedOutcome: User lands on the sign-up page and can create an account

failureModes.result: Same lead-capture modal opens — no redirect to /platform. Nav still shows 'Sign in' button even when authenticated.

name: Email login
persona: Returning user who already has an account and wants to access their chatbot analytics dashboard
preconditions: User is not already logged in
User knows their email and password

steps.action: Navigate to /auth/login — form visible with 'Welcome back.' heading, Email field, Password field, 'Sign in' button
Enter email address (info@openbat.dev)
Enter password
Click 'Sign in' button
Verify redirect to /platform — dashboard shows 'Sophie Finance' org with chatbot list

expectedOutcome: User is redirected to /platform showing their organization's chatbot list

failureModes.result: Inline error shown in red: 'Invalid email or password'. Form stays on /auth/login.

alternativePaths: Navigate to /auth/sign-up via 'Create an account' link

name: Email sign up
description: Register a new account with work email and password
persona: New user who wants to set up chatbot analytics for the first time
preconditions: User does not already have an account
User has access to their work email

steps.action: Navigate to /auth/sign-up — 'Get started.' heading with Work email, Password (min 8 chars), Confirm password fields, 'Create account' button, Terms/Privacy links

expectedOutcome: Account is created and verified. User can now log in and is redirected to /platform where an organization is auto-created.

failureModes.result: Generic error: 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' — not specific about password length. UX could be improved.
Specific client-side validation: 'Passwords do not match.'
Generic error: 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' — same generic message as password-too-short (good for security, doesn't reveal account existence, but confusing UX)

name: Password reset request
persona: Existing user who cannot remember their password
preconditions: User has an existing account with a verified email

steps.action: Navigate to /auth/forgot-password — 'Forgot your password?' heading with Email field, 'Send reset link' button, 'Back to sign in' link
Enter email (info@openbat.dev) and click 'Send reset link'
Success state: 'RESET LINK SENT' badge, 'If info@openbat.dev is registered, a reset link is on its way. The link expires in one hour.'

expectedOutcome: User's password is updated and they can log in with the new password

failureModes.result: Same success message: 'If nonexistent@nobody.com is registered, a reset link is on its way.' — correct security practice, doesn't reveal account existence.

name: Create new chatbot
description: Create a new chatbot and start the onboarding wizard
persona: Team admin or owner who wants to set up analytics for a new chatbot
preconditions: User has owner or admin role in the organization

steps.action: Navigate to /platform — chatbot list visible with Active/Pending/Archive/Demo tabs
Click '+ New chatbot' — modal opens with Name field (0/100 char counter) and 'Continue to setup' button
Enter chatbot name ('Flow Test Bot') and click 'Continue to setup'

Redirected to 9-step onboarding wizard (Basics, Product, Brand, Pricing, Competitors, Analysis, Personas, Calibrate, Connect) — Step 1 shows Product name, Website URL, Documentation URL (MCP), and demo preview chatbot
Test chatbot created then deleted via Pending tab → three-dot menu → Delete with confirmation dialog

expectedOutcome: New chatbot is created with an API key, and user is guided through SDK setup on the onboarding page

name: Explore demo chatbot
description: Browse a read-only demo chatbot dashboard with sample data
persona: New user evaluating OpenBat, or existing user wanting to see what a fully populated dashboard looks like

steps.action: Navigate to /platform — on Pending tab, switch to Demo tab

Click 'Demo' tab — 2 demo chatbots visible: 'Demo Chatbot — E-Commerce' (Threadworks Co.) and 'Demo Chatbot — SaaS' (Helmsmith), both marked 'Provided by OpenBat' and 'Explore reports, browse the UI — no writes'

Click E-Commerce demo — full dashboard loads with DEMO banner, AI chat, AT-RISK ORGS, ALERTS (13 buying signals), PERFORMANCE (Resolution 54%, Sentiment positive, 3 quality issues, AI Literacy 74/100), full sidebar navigation

expectedOutcome: User sees a fully populated dashboard with sample conversations, analyses, and reports — all read-only

name: Invite team member
description: Send an invitation to a colleague to join the organization
persona: Organization owner who wants to give a colleague access to chatbot analytics
preconditions: User has owner or admin role

steps.action: Navigate to /platform/members — member table visible with current member (info@openbat.dev, Owner, May 15, 2026)

Click '+ Invite member' — modal opens with Email field, Organization role dropdown (Member), Chatbot access checkboxes (Sophie, E-Commerce Demo, SaaS Demo) with 'Select all', chatbot role dropdown (Viewer), Cancel/Send invitation buttons

expectedOutcome: Invitation email is sent. Invitee clicks the link to accept and join the organization.

name: Ask AI about chatbot data
description: Ask a natural-language question to the platform AI assistant about chatbot analytics
persona: Product manager who wants quick answers without writing queries
preconditions: User is on the chatbot dashboard

steps.action: On Sophie dashboard, view message input field with command hints (@ tag entity, $ scope by plan, # user analysis, ! assistant analysis, ^ scope by prompt)
Type 'What's driving negative sentiment?' and click Submit — URL updates with ?c= conversation ID, question shown in chat view

expectedOutcome: AI responds with relevant data, charts, and insights based on the chatbot's conversation data

failureModes.trigger: Submit a question — AI backend returns errors (401/404/400/422)
failureModes.result: Silent failure: question appears in chat but no AI response, no error message, no loading indicator timeout. User sees empty chat forever.

name: Create report from template
description: Create a dashboard report using a pre-built template
persona: CS manager who wants a weekly sentiment overview without building from scratch

steps.action: Navigate to /platform/[chatbotId]/reports — 'START FROM A TEMPLATE' section with 4 templates (Customer Pulse, Sentiment Distribution, Risk Flags Leaderboard, Topics & Intents Overview), 'Your reports' section with 'No reports yet'
Click 'Customer Pulse' template card

Report created and loaded — shows CONVERSATIONS (200), AVG SENTIMENT (0), TOTAL MESSAGES (400), SENTIMENT TREND (No data). Filters: Last 30 days, Prompt: All versions. Actions: + Add chart, Customize, Pin, Delete. Chat button for copilot.

expectedOutcome: A new report is created with pre-populated widgets showing relevant chatbot analytics

name: Create workflow from template
description: Create an automated workflow from a pre-built template
persona: CS manager who wants Slack notifications when churn risk is detected

steps.action: Navigate to /platform/[chatbotId]/workflows — tabs: Workflows, Runs, Templates. 'No workflows yet' shown.
Click 'Templates' tab — filter pills (All, Public, Your Org | Alerting, Escalation, Reporting, Moderation, General). 1 template: 'Notify Slack when an organization becomes at risk' (Public, Alerting)
Click template — preview panel shows title, description, tags (Alerting, Public), Workflow Steps (Organization at risk → Slack notification), 'Use This Template' button

expectedOutcome: Workflow is created and will trigger automatically when conditions are met during conversation analysis

name: Create new prompt version
description: Edit the system prompt and create a new version
persona: Engineer who wants to fix a hallucination pattern identified in analysis by editing the system prompt

steps.action: Navigate to /platform/[chatbotId]/system-prompt — mode progression (Manual → Half-automated → Fully Automated), tabs (Prompt, Experiments, Suggested), current version v6.0 LIVE, Actions (Publish mode, Kill switch OFF, Roll back v5.0), version history
Click '+ New version' — side panel 'Draft 1' opens with Manual/AI Suggest tabs, editable PROMPT TEXT, DIFF VS ACTIVE ('No changes vs active'), Discard/Save & close/Publish buttons
Click Discard — confirmation dialog: 'Discard this draft? This deletes the draft permanently. The active published prompt is unaffected.' Click 'Discard draft' — draft deleted

expectedOutcome: New prompt version is published and the chatbot uses it for future conversations
alternativePaths: AI Suggest mode for AI-generated changes

name: Review a specific conversation
description: View a specific conversation's full message thread and analysis results
persona: CS manager investigating a flagged interaction to understand why a customer expressed frustration

steps.action: Navigate to /platform/[chatbotId]/conversations — table with User, Messages, Outcome, Issues, Sentiment, Flags, Last Message columns. Search/filter bar. Date filter: Last 30 days.

Click first conversation row — detail page loads with full message thread: user message 'How much did I spend last month?' (translated from Latvian), assistant response with REASONING, TOOL calls (search_tran, summarize_s, aggregate_t), and formatted answer '€4,019.32'. Right panel shows Analysis Overview (Flag: data visibility query, Outcome: Msg #2), Persona section, General/User/Assistant tabs.

expectedOutcome: User understands the full context of the conversation including analysis tags, flags, and outcomes

name: Configure analysis definitions
description: Add or modify analysis definitions for conversation analysis
persona: Product lead who wants to add a custom flag for 'pricing_complaint' specific to their product
preconditions: User has admin or owner role

steps.action: Navigate to /platform/[chatbotId]/analysis-config — tabs: Integration, Metadata, Translation, User Analysis, Assistant Analysis, Calibration, Personas. Shows '4 of 5 layers active' with layer progression (Baseline, Prompt, Tools, Knowledge, Synced).

Click 'User Analysis' tab — shows Sentiment section (Very Negative/Negative/Positive/Very Positive with color, priority, enabled toggles), AI Literacy section, Flags section with '+ Add custom' button for defining new flag types

expectedOutcome: New analysis definition is active and will be detected in future conversations

name: Export conversation data
description: Download chatbot conversation data for external analysis
persona: Data analyst who needs chatbot conversation data for custom analysis in their own tools

steps.action: Navigate to /platform/[chatbotId]/settings — tabs: General, Billing, Company Info, API Keys, Members, Webhooks, Import/Export Data

Click 'Import/Export Data' tab — Export section: Format dropdown (JSON), 'Include analysis results' checkbox (checked), '1,208 messages across all conversations', Export button. Import section: Upload JSON/CSV, Download template CSV, Choose File + Import button.

expectedOutcome: Complete conversation data file is downloaded with all messages and optionally analysis results
